episodes.synopsis: The names of those advancing to the second round of the Chopin competition are announced, and Shuhei is shocked when Adamski fails to make the cut.
episodes.title: Chopin's Journey

episodes.synopsis: Following Sophie Ormesson, Wei Pang takes the stage. Though deeply influenced by Ajino, he demonstrates a depth and pain not found in Ajino's playing.
episodes.title: Fixation

episodes.synopsis: Out of the remaining 30 pianists, only 12 will advance to the final round. Shuhei takes the stage with just one goal in mind for his performance.
episodes.title: Awakening

episodes.synopsis: Lech Szymanowski performs with his sister, Emilia in his heart. Despite the hometown preference for a Polish contestant, Kai's playing wows the crowd.
episodes.title: Promise

episodes.synopsis: Once Kai's finishes his performance, it's all up to the judges. But one judge argues against allowing Kai to advance and requests a complete recount.
episodes.title: The Dance of Deliberation

episodes.synopsis: After the results are announced, Kai catches Shuhei at a bad time. The next day, they have a painful conversation in a park.
episodes.title: Requiem

episodes.synopsis: In the last round, pianists perform with an orchestra. Rumors fly when Wei Pang doesn't show up as scheduled, while Kai worries about Shuhei.
episodes.title: For the Sake of Your Number One

episodes.synopsis: After reuniting in a practice room at the Chopin Academy, Kai and Shuhei take a morning walk through Warsaw. Shuhei is shocked by Kai's plans.
episodes.title: The Truth About Wei Pang

episodes.synopsis: A painful article is published about Wei Pang's past, but all he cares about is Ajino's opinion. Before Pang takes the stage, they meet on the stairs.
episodes.title: For Your Living Evidence

episodes.synopsis: Though Lech wants to win for his sister's sake, the final day is Kai's chance to show the world who he is and how far he's come with his performance.
episodes.title: In the Country Where Chopin Was Born

episodes.synopsis: Kai's performance is a triumph, but Lech has the final slot -- and hometown support. As he plays, he has a vision of his sister, Emilia.
episodes.title: Hero

episodes.synopsis: The winners are finally announced to an electrified audience. Shuhei sheds tears of joy when he hears Kai's placement. Ajino receives shocking news.
episodes.title: The Best Pianist in the World
